visible_content: {"issues":[{"claim_span_id":"cc-claim-cc4-deliverer-blank-zh","status":"insufficient_evidence","nature":"insufficient_evidence","category":"relationship","severity":"medium","explanation":"驿站记录只载明药箱于辰时送达北营、送件人一栏空白，草稿却以该记录为依据断言送件人是阿蘅，该身份归属缺乏记录支撑。","reasoning":"Y1 记载送达时间与地点，同时明确送件人一栏空白，未给出任何送件人信息；Y2 只说明北营相对驿站的位置，与谁送达无关。草稿把「驿站记录表明」当作阿蘅送件的依据，但记录恰缺少决定性的送件人环节，无法据此确认或排除阿蘅，判断只能止于证据不足。","temporal_basis":{"claim_anchor":null,"evidence_anchor":null,"relation":"unknown"},"evidence":[{"chapter_id":"cc-chapter-cc4-deliverer-blank-zh-Y1","span_id":"cc-span-cc4-deliverer-blank-zh-Y1","relation":"context","sufficiency":"insufficient","related_memory_ids":["cc-memory-cc4-deliverer-blank-zh-Y1"]}],"evidence_chain":[{"span_id":"cc-span-cc4-deliverer-blank-zh-Y1","role":"missing_link"}],"suggested_revision":null,"available_actions":[]}],"claim_verdicts":[{"claim_span_id":"cc-claim-cc4-deliverer-blank-zh","verdict":"insufficient_evidence","basis":"记录仅载药箱辰时送达北营且送件人栏空白，未指明送件人；草稿据此归属阿蘅缺乏决定性环节，属证据不足而非直接矛盾。"}]}
